items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well, it was Wood and Joe. Used to play at the place of Burns Hall for parties on Sundays.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Well now, what was the first music you remember or singing or anything as a kid?
Well, it was Wood and Joe. Used to play at the place of Burns Hall for parties on Sundays. Mm-hmm.
Would that be in the afternoon or night?
